title: One-Way Quantum Symmetric Private Information Retrieval Protocol From A Single Database Server Using NISQ Devices
summary: Symmetric private information retrieval (SPIR) lets an inquirer obtain one specific bit only, without leaking any information about its index to the database owner. With a single server, this is impossible for parties with unrestricted quantum power.
